title: OpenAI says it corrected a GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol launch billing mistake that had incorrectly discounted usage; Astra users will now hit their limits 40% faster (Graham Barlow/TechRadar)
summary: Graham Barlow / TechRadar: OpenAI says it corrected a GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol launch billing mistake that had incorrectly discounted usage; Astra users will now hit their limits 40% faster — Too little, too late? … - OpenAI has admitted to a billing mistake with its new GPT-6.2 models — You'll now hit your usage limits up to 40% faster
